Ordinance No. 18248 was amended by Ordinance No. 20331, passed by the Dallas City  Council on June 14, 1989. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18248; 20331; 25423)
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 176 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text: ARTICLE 176. PD 176.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 176 was established by Ordinance No. 18248, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 2, 1984. Ordinance No. 18248 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 18248 was amended by Ordinance No. 20331, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 14, 1989. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 18248; 20331; 25423)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 176 is established on property generally located at the southwest corner of Caruth Haven Lane and North Central Expressway. The size of PD 176 is approximately 7.135 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-176.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Site Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.104.SITE PLAN. Use of the Property must comply with the site plan (Exhibit 176A). (Ord. Nos. 18248; 20331; 25423)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.105.LANDSCAPE PLAN. Prior to the issuance of any building permit, a landscape plan must be submitted to the city plan commission for review and approval. The landscape plan may be phased to coincide with the phasing of development. Each phase must fully comply with the requirements of Article X, “Landscape Regulations.” (Ord. Nos. 20331; 25423)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.106.USES. The only permitted uses of the Property are those uses permitted in an Office-2 District, as defined in Chapter 51, except that drive-in windows for a bank or savings and loan are not permitted. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.107.HEIGHT. Maximum permitted height for buildings and structures on the Property is 42 feet. The measurement must be taken from an elevation of 618 feet above mean sea level. (Ord. Nos. 20331; 25423)

sections.title: Stories
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.108.STORIES. No building on the Property may have more than three floor levels. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423)

sections.title: Visual Intrusion
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.109.VISUAL INTRUSION. Any third floor balcony, door, or window located on the west facade of any structure must be screened to prevent visual surveillance of the residential area to the west. (Ord. Nos. 20331; 25423)

sections.title: Floor Area
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.110.FLOOR AREA. Maximum permitted floor area for all buildings combined on the Property is 215,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.111.SIGNS. All signs on the Property must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII, “Sign Regulations.” (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-176.112.PARKING.
(a)Parking for office uses. Off-street parking for office uses must be provided at a ratio of one space per 333 square feet of floor area. Prior to the issuance of a building permit authorizing the construction of a building or structure that would cause the total office floor area of all buildings or structures on the Property to collectively exceed 190,000 square feet, the owner may submit a traffic management plan to the director of public works and transportation for review and approval. If approved, off-street parking for all additional office floor area may be provided at the ratio of one space per 375 square feet of floor area.
(b)All other uses. Off-street parking for all other uses must be provided in accordance with Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 20331; 25423)

sections.title: Access
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.113.ACCESS. Vehicular access to the Property must be as shown on the approved conceptual plan. No vehicular access is permitted to or from the properties to the south and west of this PD. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.114.SCREENING. A minimum six-foot-high solid masonry wall must be built and maintained in good condition on the south and west property lines of this PD, as shown on the site plan. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.115.SETBACKS. Setbacks must be provided as shown on the site plan. (Ord. Nos. 20331; 25423)

sections.title: Phasing
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.116.PHASING. Development is limited to a maximum of five phases, beginning with Phase E and ending with Phase A, as shown on the conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.117.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS. Utilization of the Property must comply all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Streets And Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.118.STREETS AND PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.119.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article and with the construction codes and all other applicable ordinances of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-176.120.ZONING MAP. PD 176 is located on Zoning Map No. G-8. (Ord. Nos. 18248; 25423)
